prompt: What insider trades happened at NVDA in the last 30 days, excluding 10b5-1 plans?
notes: get_transactions is the filtered search (ticker, date range, 10b5-1 exclusion). research_company only flags 10b5-1 rows, it cannot exclude them.

prompt: What Form 4 filings just came in? I want to see what insiders are filing right now across the whole market.
notes: get_recent_filings is the unfiltered live feed, newest first. Its description says to use it for 'what just happened'.

prompt: Show me the latest Form 4 filings for AAPL.
notes: Live feed optionally filtered to one ticker. list_filings is described as company filing HISTORY with paging, so it is not the first call for 'latest'.

prompt: Which companies have insider cluster buys this week, where several insiders bought at the same company?
notes: get_signals finds which companies have cluster buy/sell signals. Business plan.

prompt: The cluster-buy signal on CROX fired recently. Why did it fire, and which insiders were in the cluster?
notes: Both get_signals and explain_signal descriptions say a named company plus 'why did it fire' goes straight to explain_signal with the ticker. Business plan.

prompt: What has Tim Cook been buying and selling lately?
notes: Only a name is given. search is described as the usual first call to resolve a person to a CIK; search_insiders is described the same way (resolve a name to a CIK before fetching transactions). Both are acceptable first calls.

prompt: List every Form 4 transaction filed by the insider with CIK 1214156.
notes: get_insider_transactions is the per-insider tool; get_transactions with insider_cik= returns the same rows per its own description.

prompt: Give me an overall career summary for insider CIK 1214156: total bought versus sold, top companies, and median returns.
notes: Pre-aggregated career rollup. Pro plan.

prompt: Is insider CIK 1214156 any good at buying? What is their hit rate on discretionary buys?
notes: Scorecard is the scored track record (hit rate, avg/median return) on discretionary buys. Pro plan.

prompt: Which insiders have the best track record on their stock purchases across the whole market?
notes: Leaderboard ranks insiders corpus-wide by buy track record; the scorecard is for one known CIK. Business plan.

prompt: Has anyone at TSLA filed a Form 144 notice of proposed sale lately? I want an early warning of upcoming insider selling.
notes: Form 144 intent-to-sell filings, filterable by ticker. Business plan.

prompt: Which institutional managers hold the most NVDA this quarter, according to 13F filings?
notes: get_holdings answers 'who owns NVDA' from 13F-HR positions, filterable by ticker and quarter. Business plan.

prompt: How much does Berkshire Hathaway manage, and when did it last file a 13F?
notes: get_managers browses the manager index with latest 13F-HR filing date and AUM; description uses the 'Berkshire' partial-name example. Business plan.

prompt: Which members of Congress have traded AAPL recently?
notes: list_congress_trades (Free, ticker filter) gives the trades; get_congress_ticker_rollup (Pro) gives the per-politician rollup for a ticker. Both fit.

prompt: Show me Nancy Pelosi's recent stock trades.
notes: get_congress_politician accepts the URL slug 'nancy-pelosi' and returns recent trades (Pro). list_congress_trades filters by bioguide ID (Free, 30-day window). Either is a correct first call depending on plan.

prompt: Are there any stocks where insiders are cluster-buying and members of Congress also bought?
notes: The insider cluster-buy x congressional purchase convergence signal. Pro plan.

prompt: What happened to TSLA's stock price after its insiders bought? Do those buys tend to beat the market?
notes: Median returns after insider buys and sells at one company with a site-wide baseline and SPY-excess figures. Pro plan.

prompt: What companies are similar to Moderna in the same industry, and which of them have the most insider filing activity?
notes: Peers by SIC code ranked by recent Form 4 activity. Not plan-gated.

prompt: Is the insider data current right now? Is ingestion stalled or running normally?
notes: get_data_quality is described as the check that the dataset is current and ingestion is not stalled; health_ingestion is the live ingestion-death detector. Both are keyless and both fit.

prompt: How big is the Form4API dataset? Give me the headline totals: filings, transactions and companies tracked.
notes: get_public_stats says to use it for corpus-wide totals; get_data_quality says it is for freshness and coverage quality. No key needed.

prompt: How many API requests have I used today, and what plan am I on?
notes: Snapshot of current usage, plan, daily limit. Needs a key.

prompt: Show me my API request counts per day for the last 14 days.
notes: Daily time series; check_usage's own description points trend questions here.

prompt: Every call returns a 401 error. Can you check whether my Form4API setup is working?
notes: verify_setup is described as the first thing to run when another tool fails with a 401/402.

prompt: Give me a full rundown of insider activity at MSFT: company profile, recent insider trades, any signals and the overall buy/sell direction.
notes: research_company bundles profile, transactions, signals, sentiment and net direction in one call and says to use it FIRST for any company research question.

prompt: What is the monthly insider sentiment score for AMZN over the past year?
notes: Monthly MSPR-style score, about 12 months by default. Business plan. research_company also embeds sentiment but is described as a bundle, so only get_sentiment is listed.
